description: Every browser storage key the visual script (sdk/visual) may use: the closed list. The names are final. revokeConsent() deletes all of them. `written` says whether this version of the script writes the key. No key ever holds a raw URL, a query string, a referrer, an editor link or a token.

keys.name: controlvar_uid
keys.holds: The visitor's random id, when the page sets no data-user-id. Its name is data-cookie-name's default.
keys.kept: 30 days (Max-Age=2592000, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, Secure on https)

keys.name: controlvar_visit
keys.holds: The visit's start and last page view, and its first page's campaign values and landing path when the tag collects them, cleaned.
keys.kept: replaced when a visit starts after 30 minutes without a page view; revokeConsent() deletes it

keys.name: controlvar_seen
keys.holds: When this browser was first seen (milliseconds since 1970), to tell a new visitor from a returning one.

keys.name: controlvar_assigned
keys.holds: The keys of the experiments this visitor was assigned to, each with the time it was last seen, so track() can name them.

keys.name: controlvar_goals
keys.holds: The goals of the experiments this visitor was assigned to (each goal's event name, kind, selector and page rule), so a goal on another page counts, and the page rules (match and path) that covered the page where each was named, so an answer there that no longer names it removes them.

keys.name: controlvar_outbox
keys.holds: Goal events the API has not yet accepted, each with the time it was made, so a later page sends them again.
keys.kept: until the API accepts or refuses it; at most 50 events, each at most 24 hours

keys.name: controlvar_pages
keys.holds: The page rules of the running visual experiments on this site (match and path), so a page none of them covers makes no call.

keys.name: controlvar_backoff
keys.holds: The time until which the script sends nothing, set after a refused or failed call.

keys.name: controlvar_preview
keys.holds: A preview link's token, so the preview lasts for the tab.

keys.name: controlvar_editor_open
keys.holds: "1" once a visual editor link was opened in this tab.
